title: Explaining What Happened
situation: The X-ray machine stopped earlier that morning. Sam asks Alex to explain when it started, what he saw, what he did first, and what he did not do.
objective: Explain a past event in order using simple past tense, answer short follow-up questions, and describe actions you did and did not take.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Alex, can you tell me what happened this morning?
dialogue.indonesian: Alex, bisakah Anda menceritakan apa yang terjadi pagi ini?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes. The X-ray machine stopped at eight thirty.
dialogue.indonesian: Bisa. Mesin X-ray berhenti pada pukul delapan tiga puluh.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Where were you when it stopped?
dialogue.indonesian: Di mana Anda saat mesin itu berhenti?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: I was near the screening line. I saw a red light on the panel.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya berada di dekat jalur pemeriksaan. Saya melihat lampu merah di panel.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: I pressed the reset button once.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya menekan tombol reset satu kali.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, it started for a moment, and then it stopped again.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, mesin menyala sebentar, lalu berhenti lagi.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Did you open the side door?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: No, I did not open the side door. I did not move the machine.
dialogue.indonesian: Tidak, saya tidak membuka pintu samping. Saya tidak memindahkan mesinnya.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, I called Jordan, my supervisor, and I wrote down the time.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, saya menelepon Jordan, supervisor saya, dan mencatat waktunya.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thank you. That is clear. I will check the error history and call you back.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Jelas sekali. Saya akan memeriksa riwayat error dan menelepon Anda kembali.

keyExpressions.english: The X-ray machine stopped at eight thirty.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Mesin X-ray berhenti pada pukul delapan tiga puluh.
keyExpressions.note: Gunakan simple past untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai.

keyExpressions.english: I was near the screening line.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya berada di dekat jalur pemeriksaan.
keyExpressions.note: Was adalah bentuk past dari am dan is.

keyExpressions.english: I saw a red light on the panel.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya melihat lampu merah di panel.
keyExpressions.note: Saw adalah bentuk past dari see.

keyExpressions.english: I pressed the reset button once.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya menekan tombol reset satu kali.
keyExpressions.note: Pressed menunjukkan tindakan yang sudah dilakukan.

keyExpressions.english: It started for a moment, and then it stopped again.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Mesin menyala sebentar, lalu berhenti lagi.

keyExpressions.english: I did not open the side door.
keyExpressions.note: Gunakan did not + kata kerja dasar.

keyExpressions.english: I called Jordan, my supervisor, and I wrote down the time.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya menelepon Jordan, supervisor saya, dan mencatat waktunya.
keyExpressions.note: Sebutkan tindakan dan informasi yang dicatat.

examples: The X-ray machine stopped at eight thirty.
The belt stopped at ten fifteen.

sentencePatterns.explanation: Menceritakan apa yang dilihat dan di mana.
examples: I saw a red light on the panel.
I saw a warning message on the screen.
I pressed the reset button once.
I pressed the start button once.
I did not open the side door.
I did not move the machine.

learningNotes: Gunakan simple past untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai: stopped, saw, pressed.
Untuk kalimat negatif, gunakan did not + kata kerja dasar: did not open.
Ceritakan urutan kejadian dengan kata first, then, dan and then.
